biblical_reference.verse_reference: And about Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam, she sang in Judges 5:23: ‘{\text{R}əʿē נָ֣א יִתְעַנְנֶךָ, יִתְעַנְנֶךָ יִתְעַנְנֶךָ, מִן הַשָּׁמָה שָׁמֶם וְשָׂמְךָ שָׁם. רְעָה שְׁאָרֶךָ, נָא כָּנָפֶיךָ בְּיַד שָׂבִיבָה, מִן מָעַן שָׁמֶךָ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים.}', // 'Rea now weeping, weep, weep; with the loud crying and wailing, Ruth, Ruth, cry out; not for the reeds of Tabor, nor for the fields of weeping, but for thee, O Deborah, sing now; cry out, cry out, cry out, Ruth, in the palm of thy hand: before the God of Israel.'
